event.description: Collapse final two-group scale to one broadcast scalar
event.proposal: family: normalization; current retained incumbent is 2677 parameters at 99.9600%, a +0.96 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family most recent accepted result: attempt-0060, two learned final LayerNorm group scales at 2844 parameters and 100.00%; same-family most recent failed result: attempt-0061, collapsing those group scales to one scalar at 2843 parameters and 10.51%; prior attempts in this family: 10. Hypothesis: the earlier one-scalar failure was measured before the current rank-7/50000-step training and scalar PAD-output calibration, so retest the smallest normalization compression in this new context: one learned scalar broadcast over both seven-channel groups. This removes one parameter for a target of 2676. It is more informative than deleting final scale entirely because it preserves global output calibration while isolating whether group-specific calibration is still necessary after the current representation changes. Keep d14/h2/L2 MQA, three shared query rows, shared head-0 output map, rank7 positions, ff23 with one shared hidden-unit vector, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, 50000 steps, and retain only official accuracy at least 99% and strictly fewer parameters than the incumbent.
